CustomField.label: Target Object
CustomField.description: Which object this value commits to, and therefore how it is read from the parsed JSON. Resume_Data__c = a single candidate-level field read from a top-level JSON key and written to the parent résumé. Work_Experience__c = a repeating role field read from each element of the workExperiences[] array and written to each child row. This parent/child routing is the one dimension a flat single-object field map does not need.
